## Quality assurance & AI policy

To respect maintainer bandwidth (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`), please confirm:

- [ ] **Manual verification:** I have read every line of this change, understand why it works, and have run it locally (`pytest`, `ruff check`, `black --check`, `mypy`).
- [ ] **AI-assisted content:** If AI tools were used, I have personally verified the logic, edge cases, style, and fit with the existing codebase. This is not a blind AI generation.
- [ ] **Scoped change:** This PR addresses a single, well-scoped issue, not several unrelated changes.
- [ ] **Tests & docs:** New behaviour has tests and docs; bug fixes have a regression test. `README.md` is updated if configuration options or the Python API changed.
- [ ] **Ready to merge:** I believe this needs minimal correction from maintainers.
